title: One sentence takes three model calls, and the write waits at a card
subtitle: Billpod's real rules. The ids and values are an example.

steps.label: mark_paid is on the confirm list

outcome.title: Loop ends: "Done, the electricity bill is marked paid via Twint."
lines: Gemini asked twice and ran nothing. Billpod's runner ran both calls, and the write waited for Approve.

captions.title: Send the sentence with the tool definitions
captions.text: Billpod sends Gemini its fixed rules, the conversation and 46 tool definitions. A definition is a name, a description and a JSON Schema for the arguments. The model reads the description as instructions.

captions.title: The model asks for a lookup; nothing has run
captions.text: The model has no bill id, and `mark_paid`'s description says the id comes from `find_bills`. So it replies with a function call: a tool name and its arguments. It is only a request.

captions.title: The runner checks the call before the handler runs
captions.text: Every call goes through `runTool`. It checks the scopes and the input, then runs the handler, which calls the same service as the REST API. Version 3 is the bill's change counter; `mark_paid` must send it back.

captions.title: Resend everything, with the call and result appended
captions.text: The model API keeps no state, so Billpod sends the same body again with the call and its result added. The result travels under role `user`. Gemini now asks for `mark_paid(b_81, v3)`.

captions.title: A write waits for the person's yes
captions.text: `mark_paid` is on Billpod's confirm list. The card is built from the stored bill, never from the model's words (example values). Billpod's request ends here; nothing is paid yet.

captions.title: Approve runs exactly the call the card showed
captions.text: The runner runs the arguments the card showed. It checks the version again, so a bill changed since the card comes back as a conflict the model can read.

captions.title: A plain-text reply ends the loop
captions.text: Billpod sends the result on a third model call. The reply is plain text, "Done, the electricity bill is marked paid via Twint.", so the loop ends.
